decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9:00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 4 - The landscape planting hereby approved shall be implemented within the first planting season following commencement of the development.

Condition : 5 - Full details of boundary fencing shall be submitted to the Council for approval in writing, prior to the works hereby approved being commenced. Details shall be carried out as approved.

Condition : 6 - Notwithstanding the approved drawings, the area adjacent to Flat 7 and the eastern side boundary of the site, fronting Brooks Road, shall remain as soft landscaping. Full details of the landscaping of this area shall be submitted to the Council for approval in writing, prior to the works hereby approved being commenced .Details shall be carried out as approved.

Condition : 7 - Notwithstanding the approved drawings, the parking layout shall be amended with bay 19 being made a standard parking bay and bay 18 to be made a disabled parking bay and two additional parking spaces (each 2.4m wide by 4.8m long) shall be provided for resident's parking in the flower bed adjacent to bay 18.

Condition : 8 - The carrying out of environmental improvements, including resurfacing, repairing, additional car parking facilities, improvements to childrens' play area, provision of new bin stores and drying areas and other related minor works, to the Pinkham Mansions estate, as shown on drawing numbers HH53/08 and HH53/09 received 23 July 2008 (Amended Plans), is satisfactory, as the proposed works would enhance the appearance and function of the external areas of the estate. The works would also not adversely affect the amenity of the residents or neighbours and would preserve and enhance the appearance and character of the conservation area. Therefore the proposed development complies with the relevant London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003 policies; ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), ENV-B.1.9 (Safety and Security), ENV-B.2.2 (Conservation Areas), H.6.2 (Environmental Improvements in Residential Areas) and T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities for Developments) of the adopted Unitary Development Plan and policies 2A.1 (Sustainability criteria), 4B.5 (Creating an inclusive environment) and 4B.8 (Respect local context and communities) of the London Plan 2008.
description: Resurfacing, repairing, additional car parking facilities, improvements to  childrens' play area, with play equipment, provision of new bin stores and drying areas and other related minor works.
